project.name: Spring + Docusaurus – JAX-RS
project.description: Demonstrates the integration of Docusaurus in a Spring Boot Application, so that the static content output from Docusaurus is served by Spring when the Application is running. Provides a useful portal exclusive to the Application that can surface Application documentation and resources (e.g. ADRs, READMEs, API docs, links etc.) through a useful user interface to both developers and non-developers alike. Also demonstrates how to display some content dynamically, such as details about the currently running application (e.g. version, build number, time since build, time since start, environment, description, etc.), which can be useful during the course of development.
